name: Paused Bench Press
instructions: Set up for a standard barbell bench press and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your chest with control.
Pause for a full 1-2 seconds with the bar resting lightly on your chest — no bouncing.
Press explosively to lockout. The pause kills momentum and builds starting strength.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An intermediate barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the chest. Paused Bench Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
